caption: The drawing is a monochromatic illustration rendered in shades of gray and black on a plain off-white background. It depicts the front elevation of a building with architectural features such as a rectangular doorway topped by a triangular pediment and flanked by columns, a series of steps leading up to the entrance, and rectangular windows on the left side of the structure. Above the doorway, there is a smaller rectangular window with a frame, and the building's façade is characterized by subtle shading that indicates depth and texture. A ribbon-like banner is drawn below the building, containing the handwritten text "1797" on the left and "Mision San Jose" across the center and right. The composition is centered on the page, with ample blank space surrounding the main subject.
title: Mision San Jose
